Register And Enroll Tracked Entity.description: Registers a new person as a tracked entity and enrolls them in a tracker program in one request.

Enroll Existing Tracked Entity.description: Enrolls an already-registered tracked entity into a program.

Record Tracker Event.description: Records a program stage event (e.g. a visit) with data values against an enrollment.

Submit Aggregate Data Values.description: Submits a monthly aggregate report (data value set) for a facility.

Upsert Tracked Entity.description: Creates a tracked entity, or updates it if the given UID already exists (CREATE_AND_UPDATE).

Upsert Organisation Unit By Code.description: Syncs a facility from a master facility list, creating or updating the organisation unit matched by code.

Update Program Metadata.description: Replaces a program's metadata (PUT requires the full object).

Delete Tracked Entity.description: Deletes a tracked entity, e.g. a duplicate registration.

Find Tracked Entities By Attribute.description: Searches tracked entities in a program by an attribute value, such as a national ID.

Get Tracked Entity By ID.description: Fetches a single tracked entity with its enrollments and events.

Get Events Updated Since Last Run.description: Exports program events updated since a given date, for incremental syncs to a data warehouse.

List Enrollments In Program.description: Lists active enrollments in a program under an organisation unit.

Export Aggregate Data Values.description: Exports the aggregate data values for a data set, facility and period.

List Organisation Units At Level.description: Lists organisation units at a hierarchy level, e.g. all health facilities.

Get Analytics Table.description: Pulls aggregated indicator values from the analytics API for reporting dashboards.

List Programs.description: Lists the programs available on the instance, with their UIDs.
